official_statement_rationale: While headline CPI inflation has reached the 4.00 per cent target, we must remain cognizant of the underlying macroeconomic dynamics. The positive output gap of 0.60 per cent and the monsoon rainfall departure of -5.0 per cent represent potential supply-side risks that could easily lead to an unanchoring of inflation expectations if we signal a premature shift in our policy resolve. Monetary policy must continue to see through these transitory shocks to ensure that the inflation trajectory remains durably aligned with our target. Given the current surplus liquidity of 120,000 Crore INR in the banking system, maintaining the stance of withdrawal of accommodation is essential to ensure orderly monetary transmission and to align liquidity conditions with our price stability objective. We must not allow the current stability to induce complacency; therefore, I vote to keep the repo rate unchanged at 6.50 per cent and maintain the stance of withdrawal of accommodation.
